para_trans: On extension of transfer of an employee of the Assistant Cell Officer Cadre of the Ministry.
Government Order No. Transfer 2026 / P.No.45 / P.S-3
Madam Cama Marg, Martyrdom Rajguru Chowk,
Reference: 1) General Administration Department, Government Order No. Replacement 2025 / Q. No. 65 / Pr. 3, D. 20.06.2025
2) General Administration Department, Government Order Serial No. 21.08.2025.
Regulation of transfers and discharge of government duties of Maharashtra Government employees.
of the reference date 20.06.2025 as provided in the Prevention of Delay Act, 2005.
By order, Shri Sadashiv Govind Naik, Assistant Cell Officer, Finance Department has been transferred to Home Department.
The transfer of Mr. Naik is now being stayed by this order on administrative grounds.
They are being given an extension of one year i.e. till the date 30.04.2027.
The Government Order is available on the Government of Maharashtra website www.maharashtra.gov.in.
